title: terminal
description: External board terminal: screw terminal, solder pad, header pin, edge-card finger, board-to-wire / board-to-board connector. A real BOM line item with measurable electrical (contact resistance, current rating) and thermal properties. Terminals exist so that every connection.endpoints in TAS carries two real component pins — the external port label alone is not a substitute for the conductor that actually crosses the board boundary. A terminal PEAS document MUST carry either designRequirements (pre-librarian seed) or manufacturerInfo (resolved real part); both may be present after the librarian binds a seed to a part.

designRequirements.description:
What the design needs from a board terminal. Lives at PEAS root inputs.designRequirements (not inside the terminal branch payload). The stencil emits this pre-librarian; the librarian uses it as the search constraint to bind a real part (e.g. Phoenix Contact MKDS, Würth WR-TBL, board headers); it is retained post-binding as the spec the part met.

Ideal-simulation floor: `category` plus `currentRating` are universally required so a behavioural terminal model (contact resistance, thermal cap) can be instantiated from the seed alone. `numPositions` defaults to 1; multi-position connectors must declare it explicitly.

category.description: Physical terminal style. Drives contact-resistance and current-rating floors as well as the librarian's distributor search space.

currentRating.description: Continuous current the terminal must carry, in amperes.

voltageRating.description: Working voltage the terminal must withstand, in volts.

contactResistanceMax.description: Maximum acceptable contact + bulk resistance, in ohms. Drives loss budget and thermal rise.

numPositions.description: Number of independent contacts on the same terminal body. 1 for screw terminals and solder pads; >1 for multi-pin headers / connectors.

datasheetInfo.description: Real terminal datasheet payload. Optional pre-librarian (the stencil emits only inputs.designRequirements); required post-librarian.

contactResistance.description: Nominal contact + bulk resistance, in ohms.

pitch.description: Centre-to-centre spacing between positions, in metres.

wireGaugeRange.description: Accepted wire cross-section range, in mm^2.
